scope: Numerical gate only; a closed total budget does not establish eddy-driven Ferrel cells
limitations: Every-step native budget uses exact SSPRK3 weights; centered mean/eddy estimates use trapezoidal three-hour snapshots.
Native-minus-centered advection difference contains interpolation and numerical-transport effects; it is not automatically a physical eddy stress.
This gate validates diagnostic operation and conservation, not cell existence, resolution convergence or statistical equilibrium.
